lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate (1) to +y down-flange (4), ~90 deg. In the part frame the line sits at y 23.4, z 0.7, on the outer arc of the corner (top skin z=1.5, flange outer face y=24.3). Along the bisector, the scan surface is at about 0 mm and the inner skin at 1.48 mm, so the line is on the outer skin; median distance to the nearest point is 0.12 mm (max 0.26). The line runs x -29.5..29.5, the full flange length (flange x -29.4..29.5). The corner is present along 97% of the line, with tiny gaps at the hole-collar locations. The two inward-extruded hole collars on the flange are not bends.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base plate (1) to the -y down-flange (9) right of the notch, ~90 deg, a trapezoid flange at y=-22. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer arc; median offset 0.08 mm. The line (x 1.6..29.4) matches the flange (x 1.8..29.2), with corner support from -1.0 to 28.5 mm of a 27.7 mm line.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base plate (1) to the -y down-flange (10) left of the notch, ~90 deg, at y=-26.7. This is a different fold from B2: the planes are offset 4.7 mm and the notch lies between them, so two lines are correct. The line is on the outer arc, median offset 0.10 mm. The extent (x -29.6..-4.0) matches the flange. The base-plate hole boss near the 25% section is not a bend.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Lower joggle bend: base plate (bottom skin 2) turning up into the joggle wall (outer face 11 at x=32.6), ~90 deg. The line at x 31.7, z 0.9 is on the outer arc, median offset 0.05 mm. The line covers y -19.4..21.7. The wall's flat face extends slightly further (-21.6..22.9), but the corner itself ends where the relief notches are (close-up), so the line covers 100% of the formed fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Upper joggle bend: wall (-x face 12) to the raised plate (top skin 3 at z=9.8), ~90 deg. The line at x 31.9, z 8.8 is on the outer arc, median offset 0.06 mm. It covers the full y -21.7..22.0 extent. The joggle rises 8.2 mm (base bottom z=0 to raised-plate bottom z=8.2), so it counts as 2 bends together with B4.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Raised plate (top 3) to its +y down-flange (14 at y=24.3), ~90 deg. The line is on the outer arc, median offset 0.11 mm. The extent x 34.5..54.5 matches flange 14 (x 34.2..54.9); corner support runs from -1.0 to 21.0 mm of a 20.1 mm line.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Raised plate (bottom 5) to the end up-tab (outer face 15 at x=59.3), ~86-94 deg. The line at x 58.2, z 9.0 is on the outer arc, median offset 0.05 mm. The extent y 10.0..21.7 matches the full tab width (y 9.9..21.7). The slight emboss around the tab hole is not a bend.
